dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Consistent, rapid 2D narrowing from the widest lateral point of the mid-body toward the visible posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with minimal undulation; symmetrical contours on both sides of the central axis.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone with uniform high pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low frequency, faint grey pixel clusters concentrated on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary white baseline and secondary greyish posterior regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A sharp, dark longitudinal mark is present along the posterior dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark linear marking is present on the midline of the lower back.
